findings.body: The new doctor test creates only an extensionless `claude` stub. Python 3.11 uses PATHEXT to find executables on Windows ([documentation](https://docs.python.org/3.11/library/shutil.html#shutil.which)), so doctor cannot discover this stub and still reports Claude missing after both skills are installed. Consequently, the success assertion at line 93 fails on a clean Windows runner. `.github/workflows/forge-next.yml:23` includes Windows, and line 35 runs the full suite with Python 3.11. Add the Windows `claude.cmd` stub already used in `tests/test_setup.py:248–249` so this test satisfies the full-suite acceptance requirement.
